caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a jug or pitcher, positioned centrally on the page. The vessel has a rounded body with a short, narrow neck, and a pronounced outwardly flared spout on the left side. A large, curved handle is attached to the right side, rising above the neck before curving down to join the body near the base. The jug is rendered in shades of grey, produced by pencil shading that gives a sense of volume and highlights, with darker tonal areas suggesting shadows and lighter areas indicating reflections. Horizontal lines circling the neck and upper body of the jug suggest decorative ridges or bands. The background is plain and light, while the page has a rectangular border drawn around the composition. Near the bottom right corner of the drawing, a faint handwritten signature is present.
title: Pewter Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
